sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is a verified relationship/path term for binding the designCondition, affected thruster components, blade-loss load case, propeller blade orientation, and evidence as required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph passes deterministic validation but is not semantically faithful: a ship-level string and a boolean sh:hasValue true on an arbitrary load case are presence-only assertions that can pass without proving plastic-bending resistance without damage or that the selected blade-loss orientation produces the maximum load on the component studied. Constrain the applicable steering mechanism, fitting, and thruster body design evidence/conditions, and bind the load case, selected orientation, maximum component load, and supporting evidence so the asserted confirmation cannot be true independently of those facts.
